mandate_common.form_subtitle: MAPA Property will personally get back to you within 24 working hours.
mandate_common.reco_text: The exclusive mandate remains our recommendation. The Luxembourg market is small; listing the same property with several agencies exposes it on the same platforms and signals a rushed sale, often unfavourable in negotiation.

mandate_exclusif.title: Exclusive Mandate
mandate_exclusif.intro: MAPA Property's reference mandate. Maximum mutual commitment, full deployment of our commercial force and confidential channels, preferred rate.
mandate_exclusif.highlight_1_title: One agency, one point of contact
mandate_exclusif.highlight_1_text: Resources concentrated, coordination simplified, consistent commercial narrative.
mandate_exclusif.highlight_2_text: Professional shoot, drone if relevant, editing. Optional, payable upon signing the mandate: amount deducted from the commission at the deed, only if MAPA Property closes the sale.
mandate_exclusif.highlight_3_text: Activation of our qualified database and partners before any public listing.
mandate_exclusif.highlight_4_text: 3% excl. VAT (+ 17% VAT): the most advantageous formula for committed sellers. Renewable term from 2 months.
mandate_exclusif.service_3: Distribution to our qualified database + off-market partners
mandate_exclusif.service_6: Distribution on specialised property portals and international platforms
mandate_exclusif.when_text: You want to sell quickly, properly, and consistently. You appreciate having a single dedicated contact who defends your price and your privacy. Statistically the best-performing mandate, and the most cost-effective.

mandate_semi_exclusif.title: Semi-Exclusive Mandate
mandate_semi_exclusif.intro: You keep your private circle in hand, MAPA Property mobilises its channels. 4% excl. VAT (+ 17% VAT), renewable term from 2 months.
mandate_semi_exclusif.highlight_1_text: You can present your property to your own circle, MAPA Property acts in parallel.
mandate_semi_exclusif.highlight_2_text: Photo, premium distribution. Video Pack as a paid option (deductible if MAPA Property closes).
mandate_semi_exclusif.highlight_3_title: Fees only if MAPA Property introduces the buyer
mandate_semi_exclusif.highlight_3_text: You only pay if the sale results from our direct or indirect intervention.
mandate_semi_exclusif.service_3: Distribution to our qualified database + partners
mandate_semi_exclusif.excluded_2: Premium off-market distribution reserved for Exclusive
mandate_semi_exclusif.when_text: You have a circle that may potentially present buyers (family, friends, neighbours, executives) and you want professional support without giving up that possibility. The balanced formula.

mandate_simple.title: Simple Mandate
mandate_simple.intro: For sought-after properties where multiple channels can run in parallel. 5% excl. VAT (+ 17% VAT), renewable term from 2 months.
mandate_simple.highlight_1_text: You retain full freedom to mandate other professionals.
mandate_simple.highlight_2_text: Listing and moderate channel activation: full marketing investment is reserved for Exclusive.
mandate_simple.highlight_3_text: 5% excl. VAT (+ 17% VAT) to offset commercial risk.
mandate_simple.when_text: Your property is highly sought-after and you want to maximise the number of channels active simultaneously, accepting that coordination will be less fluid. Statistically the least performing, but sometimes relevant.

mandate_autonome.title: Autonomous Mandate
mandate_autonome.intro: For sellers who wish to manage viewings and negotiations themselves, but want professional legal and notarial backup. 1% excl. VAT (+ 17% VAT), renewable term from 2 months.
mandate_autonome.highlight_1_title: You stay in the driver's seat
mandate_autonome.highlight_1_text: Listing, viewings, negotiation: you handle it. We step in on request.
mandate_autonome.highlight_2_text: Compromise, suspensive conditions, notarial coordination: handled by MAPA Property.
mandate_autonome.highlight_3_text: 1% excl. VAT (+ 17% VAT) for the legal and notarial side only.
mandate_autonome.when_text: You want to handle the sale of your property yourself and keep control of every step? This mandate gives you that freedom. Our team remains available at any time should you wish to be supported.

mandate_recherche.title: Search Mandate
mandate_recherche.intro: The European answer to the buyer's agent. You entrust us with the mission of finding your future property and overseeing its acquisition, in Luxembourg or abroad. Under exclusive mandate, in your sole interest.
mandate_recherche.highlight_1_title: Advice that serves only one master
mandate_recherche.highlight_1_text: We defend exclusively your buyer's interest. No double agency.
mandate_recherche.highlight_2_text: Activation of our network of confidential partners in France, Luxembourg, UAE, Spain, etc.
mandate_recherche.highlight_3_text: Under mandate signed in Luxembourg, we operate as broker in numerous premium cities across several countries.
mandate_recherche.highlight_4_text: You only pay if we find and the sale closes. Limited upfront.
mandate_recherche.service_5: Negotiation, conducted directly or overseen through our locally licensed partner abroad, and due diligence
mandate_recherche.when_title: When to choose the search mandate
mandate_recherche.when_text: You don't have the time or the network to identify the ideal property yourself, or you are looking abroad (where market opacity is high). You want advice that defends exclusively your interest, not a broker serving two masters.
mandate_recherche.advance_p1: Every search mandate carries a fee advance, fully deducted from our fees if the transaction concludes with MAPA Property.
mandate_recherche.advance_p2: Luxembourg: €250 excluding VAT. Neighbouring regions, up to 100 km: from €500 excluding VAT. Other countries: by quotation, depending on the travel required.
mandate_recherche.advance_p3: Why this advance: a search mandate commits us to working exclusively on your project. We stop offering the properties we identify to other buyers, we activate our network, we visit and qualify before presenting anything to you. This time is real, it precedes any transaction, and it cannot be free. The advance formalises this mutual commitment: you commit to a defined project, and we commit our resources to it.

page_sell.step_one_text: Visit, audit, market study, presentation price calibration.
page_sell.step_two_text: Tailored mandate signed, professional photos, off-market then public distribution as per strategy.
page_sell.step_three_text: Buyer selection, negotiation, compromise, deed. We stay by your side until the end.
page_sell.estimate_text: Our simulator gives you an indicative range in under 2 minutes. The visit makes it accurate.

page_rent.manage_text: Collection, charges, claims, end of lease. A modular formula tailored to your needs.
page_rent.legal_notice: The Luxembourg cap is 5% of invested capital per year. MAPA Property guarantees strict compliance with this rule, which protects both tenant and landlord.

about_page.title: Real estate isn't sold. It's entrusted.
about_page.intro: MAPA Property: Luxembourg real estate agency and international broker. Under mandate, within a framework, in your sole interest.
about_page.para_1: MAPA Property brings together two partners who have practised real estate for nearly ten years, and an agency founded in Luxembourg in 2024. Our backgrounds in finance taught us the discipline of the verified detail and the value of discretion. These two principles shape the way we work.
about_page.para_2: We work under mandate, for a single interest at a time. This is the Anglo-Saxon buyer's agent model: when we represent a buyer, we defend that buyer alone, from the search through to signing. When we represent a seller, we defend their price and their terms. Our clients sense this clarity from the very first conversation.
about_page.para_3: Artificial intelligence is part of our everyday toolkit. It helps us cross-reference market data, spot properties before they come to market, and structure an analysis in a few hours where it once took days. But no algorithm walks through a door in our place, reads a room, or senses what is really at stake in a negotiation. Technology saves time. Judgement remains ours.
about_page.para_4: A significant part of our activity never appears anywhere. Confidential sales, off-market properties, bespoke searches: we operate away from the shop window, because that is exactly what our clients come to us for. Everything runs through a written framework: signed mandate, defined brief, contractual confidentiality. This discipline lets us move quickly and with peace of mind.
about_page.para_5: Over nearly ten years in the profession, we have advised several hundred clients: international families, executives, investors, family offices. Many would tell you they have never come across us in an advertisement. That is by design.
about_page.bio_julien: I am the co-founder of MAPA Property and my role is Real Estate Director and also Exclusive Sourcing Specialist.

arcova.title: ARCOVA · the MAPA Property private access
arcova.intro: ARCOVA is the confidential space reserved for qualified clients under MAPA Property mandate: complete off-market files, confidential proposals and secure exchanges, by invitation only.
arcova.problem_text: In premium real estate, the bulk of high-value transactions are negotiated privately, outside the public market: close to two-thirds of high-end operations go through private and advised channels rather than open listings. But without a common framework, this so-called "confidential" market is rarely confidential in practice: a single property circulates from network to network, by email and messaging, through multiple intermediaries within weeks. The owner loses control of distribution, the price drifts with each intermediary, the property's characteristics end up diverging from one version to another. There is neither traceability, nor protection, nor recourse in case of a leak.
arcova.consequences_item_1: Price inflation: each intermediary adds their margin, and the displayed price drifts away from the real one.
arcova.consequences_item_2: Information drift: surface, rooms, land, sale terms diverge from one version to another.
arcova.consequences_item_3: Reputational damage: to the owner as much as to the mandated professional.
arcova.consequences_item_4: Over-exposure: the property paradoxically becomes more visible than a public listing.
arcova.consequences_item_5: Limited conversion: qualified buyers have already received several contradictory versions.
arcova.consequences_item_6: No recourse: without a contractual framework, neither evidence nor protection in case of a leak.
arcova.valuation_text: Conversely, a truly controlled and confidential off-market property is better valued: private prestige transactions close with a meaningful premium compared to publicly marketed equivalents. Properly protected confidentiality is an asset, not a weakness.
arcova.response_text: ARCOVA enforces a qualified and traceable access protocol. Each member is verified (KYC/AML) and signs a contractual NDA before any access. Each file becomes a unique time-stamped reference; each consultation is logged. The confidentiality of the property, the control over its distribution and the interest of each party are protected end to end.
arcova.protect_title: What ARCOVA protects, for each profile
arcova.protect_owners_text: real and contractually protected confidentiality, full control over distribution, protection of the sale price, access to an international network of qualified buyers.
arcova.protect_brokers_text: preserved reputation, unique and consistent file version, protected commission, reduced bypass risk.
arcova.protect_buyers_text: access to genuinely off-market properties, reliable and verified information, end-to-end secure transactions, protective legal framework.
arcova.platform_note: The ARCOVA platform will be available very shortly. In the meantime, we already apply all these conditions (qualified access, contractual confidentiality, NDA) through direct request by email or message.
arcova.waitlist_text: ARCOVA access is granted case by case, after an interview and the signature of a contractual NDA. To join the waitlist, contact us directly.
arcova.legal: Strictly nominative access · Contractual confidentiality · Audit log active

mentions_acquisition.meta_description: Legal information and limitations of the MAPA Property acquisition cost simulator.
mentions_acquisition.title: Acquisition cost simulator, full legal notice
mentions_acquisition.intro: The real estate acquisition cost simulator provided by MAPA Property is a decision-support tool. The notices below set out its scope, limitations and the legal framework applicable to its use.
mentions_acquisition.s1_body: The estimates produced by the simulator are based on the compilation of official public sources (tax administrations, notarial chambers, regulatory authorities, ministries of finance and equivalent bodies) in the nine covered countries. All sources are identified and time-stamped within the simulator interface. The most recent global verification date is 12 May 2026. Rates, allowances, scales and thresholds may evolve between two verifications without MAPA Property being informed in real time.
mentions_acquisition.s2_body: The figures displayed are strictly indicative. They do not constitute an offer, a commitment, or any form of tax, legal, notarial, financial or investment advice. They may not be relied upon as binding against MAPA SYNERGY Sàrl or any of its representatives. No document generated by the simulator has any evidentiary or contractual value before a notary, tax authority, bank or court.
mentions_acquisition.s3_body: The simulator covers nine countries: Luxembourg, France, Belgium, Germany, Monaco, Switzerland, Italy, Spain and Portugal. Costs included are registration / transfer duties, regulated notarial fees, VAT applicable to new-build, and the main common-law allowances (first-time buyer, primary residence, family profile). Excluded are: agency fees, technical diagnostics, annual local taxes, condominium charges, loan interest, insurance, banking fees, currency conversion, the buyer's personal taxation (IR, IFI, capital gains) and any post-acquisition costs. Regional variability (German Länder, Spanish autonomous communities, Belgian regions, Swiss cantons) is integrated at the finest available granularity but remains indicative. Real estate regulation evolves frequently: a check with a locally licensed notary at the effective transaction date is essential.
mentions_acquisition.s4_title: 4. Limitation of liability, MAPA SYNERGY Sàrl
mentions_acquisition.s4_body: MAPA SYNERGY Sàrl (RCS Luxembourg B241974, VAT LU 31988923, AE N°10108681/0-1-2-3), operating the MAPA Property brand, together with its directors, employees, partners and service providers, expressly declines any civil, tax or criminal liability with respect to the accuracy, completeness, availability or timeliness of the information displayed by the simulator, and with respect to acquisition, financing or investment decisions made on the basis of these estimates. No claim for damages may be brought against MAPA SYNERGY Sàrl on this basis.
mentions_acquisition.s5_body: The user acknowledges that use of the simulator does not in any way release them from the MANDATORY consultation of a locally licensed notary in the country of acquisition, as well as, where applicable, of an independent tax advisor and a specialised lawyer. Any binding decision (signing of a preliminary contract, payment of a deposit, loan application, tax declaration) must rely on contradictory figures provided by these professionals and not on the simulator's estimates.
mentions_acquisition.s6_body: For a personalised, contradictory and secured analysis of your acquisition project, MAPA Property makes available its network of partner notaries, tax advisors and lawyers in the nine covered countries. Our scope of intervention extends from the Luxembourg trophy asset to international wealth investment, under a signed search mandate.
mentions_acquisition.s7_body: This notice is governed by Luxembourg law. Any dispute relating to the use of the simulator or the interpretation of this notice shall fall within the exclusive jurisdiction of the District Courts of Luxembourg, notwithstanding plurality of defendants or third-party proceedings.
mentions_acquisition.s8_body: MAPA SYNERGY Sàrl reserves the right to modify, at any time and without notice, the parameters, sources and methodologies of the simulator as well as this legal notice. The version in force is the one accessible at the moment the simulator is used. It is the user's responsibility to keep informed of updates.
